output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # diagonal halos, then full row/column rays overwrite halos
    for r,c in pts:
        for dr,dc in ((-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=3
    for r,c in pts:
        for j in range(w): out[r][j]=1
        for i in range(h): out[i][c]=1
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=2
    return out"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    # rays/crosses
    for r,c in pts:
        for j in range(w): out[r][j]=1
        for i in range(h): out[i][c]=1
    # diagonals only where not cross (cross has precedence)
    for r,c in pts:
        for dr,dc in ((-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)):
            i,j=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w and out[i][j] not in (1,2): out[i][j]=3
    # centers last
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=2
    return out"}
